core_meaning.primary_meaning: Saeeda is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Happy, fortunate”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Saeeda corresponds to the Arabic form سَعِيدَة (Arabic root س ع د (s-ʿ-d); سَعِيدَة (Saʿīda)). Its core sense is saeeda; happy, fortunate (feminine). Saeeda is Arabic سَعِيدَة (Saʿīda) 'happy, fortunate' (feminine), from the root س ع د (s-ʿ-d). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave سائ دة (a broken form). The source gloss 'Lady, Mistress' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as sa-idah.

persian.name: سعیده
persian.long_meaning: Saeeda (سعیده) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن سعیده، خوشبخت است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: सईदा

pashto.name: سعیده

arabic.name: سَعِيدَة
